## Summary of Changes

Describe what this Pull Request changes and why. Include motivation, context, and links to any related issues.

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code style / refactoring (no functional changes)

## Affected Areas
- [ ] Desktop UI (`server/desktop/` or `src/app/`)
- [ ] Electron Main & IPC (`server/electron/`)
- [ ] Local HTTP Core Server (`server/core/`)
- [ ] Web Client (`client/`)
- [ ] Shared Types (`shared/`)
- [ ] Build & CI/CD (`package.json`, `.github/`)

## Testing Done
Describe the tests you ran to verify your changes:
- [ ] Built the full project successfully (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Ran automated tests (`npm test`)
- [ ] Verified manual file sharing and browser client streaming
- [ ] Tested on Windows / Linux
